title: DEPHYRIER Doze a Trinta e Tres (Full DOM Count)
style: counting pulse 104 bpm trilingual EN PT FR DEPHYRIER signature DOM-query-tone undercount-correction terminal-pulse spoken-portuguese ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
First pass said twelve the bottom of the list
User pushed back said you missed what was missed
Queried full DOM and the count came clean
Thirty three before the handover seen

[Pre-Chorus — Portuguese]
Doze virou trinta e três a contagem real
(Twelve became thirty-three the real count)
Query completo não parcial
(Full query not partial)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER twelve to thirty three the count
Doze a trinta e três a verdade encontrada
(Twelve to thirty-three the truth found)
Douze à trente trois la liste corrigée
(Twelve to thirty-three the list corrected)

[Verse 2]
Visible portion is not the whole tale
Virtualization hides the rows behind the rail
Query the document not just the screen
Undercount admitted the lesson is seen

[Bridge — French]
La partie visible n'est pas tout le DOM
(The visible portion is not the whole DOM)
Interroge le document pas le zóom
(Query the document not the zoom)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER twelve thirty three count true
Doze trinta e três la cuenta correcta
DEPHYRIER douze trente trois plus de doute
